Lower Text: [All Turns] While this Digimon has the [Angel] or [Seven Great Demon Lords] trait, it gains ＜Scapegoat＞. (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by one of your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, prevent that deletion.)
